title: Triggered ability "When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, [Stun] it. They can't move it this turn." never fires
expected: vex-apathetic.ts:4-18 defines the UnitCard with only rulesText and no `abilities` array at all — neither Deflect nor the "When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, Stun it / can't move" trigger is implemented as an executable ability. No engine-side special-casing of unl-150-219 exists (only a rulings test references it). So the trigger cannot fire; card-layer bug confirmed.
observed: Player-2 played Vanguard Attendant to base while Vex sat at battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-277-298: no chain item, no pendingChoice, unit meta.stunned=false, standardMove was enumerated for it and executing standardMove succeeded (unit moved to player-2-bf-ogn-277-298). Parsed ability in unl.json is a static 'sequence' with effects:[] (description only) — the trigger was not parsed into an executable ability.
